items.title: Jim Robinson Interview, 1958-12-10
items.q: I played the first brass band I played was for the Jefferson Buzzard, it was on the Carmel Day, with Willie Parker.

ctx.x: I wondered, when was the first brass band on the street that you played?
I played the first brass band I played was for the Jefferson Buzzard, it was on the Carmel Day, with Willie Parker.

items.title: Jim Robinson Interview, 1961-06-15
items.q: And that was the first parade I played too. Budapetit. With old man Parker, Willie Parker.

ctx.x: What ones? What was your first brass band you ever played with? I'll put it that way.

The first brass band I played with. See the New Orleans? That was on the carnival day, Budapetit. Budapetit on the carnival day. And that was the first parade I played too. Budapetit. With old man Parker, Willie Parker.
